Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", "{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":false,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.5}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
